economic_hypothesis: The transition between multi-bar and current-bar market breadth and the concentration of contemporaneous trading activity reveal whether an individual move is being confirmed or opposed by cross-sectional participation.

factor_families.breadth_recovery_continuation: current positive breadth minus multi-bar positive breadth>10%, ret1>0.2%
factor_families.breadth_deterioration_resilience: breadth transition<-10%, stock ret1>0.3% and ret3>0
factor_families.broad_positive_volume_continuation: current positive breadth>60%, ret1>0.3%, volume acceleration>1
factor_families.concentrated_activity_continuation: top-decile volume share>25%, stock volume rank>90%, ret1>0.3%

hard_gates.native_factory_null: run only after all pre-null gates
